description: Use this when a contractor describes a job (what they saw on site, what needs doing, quantities) and wants an itemized quote. Builds the draft only from the contractor's own price book; lines with no match are flagged and left unpriced, never guessed. Side effects: saves a new draft quote in the contractor's FieldDraft account each time it is called (calling again creates another draft) and counts toward the account's monthly draft allowance. The description and any photo links are sent to FieldDraft's AI provider to produce the draft. Nothing is sent to the customer or to Jobber. Do not use for general pricing questions or for jobs the user has not described.

jobDescription.description: The contractor's description of the job in their own words, including quantities and site conditions

photoUrls.description: Public image URLs of the job site, only if the user shared them; they are fetched for the AI model

name: draft_quote
title: Draft a quote
